verdict.rationale: Pulley allows exporting the cap table as an Excel file for a specific date or all-time, which is an open format export of core data, but there's no evidence of full data export (all documents, stakeholder details, transaction history, agreements) in open formats or documented account-closure/data-portability workflow. missing for 10: comprehensive full-account data export, open-format export of all documents/agreements/records, explicit data portability policy.
